papers.title: Delegate Pricing to Algorithms: When Slow and Steady Wins the Race
papers.summary: When firms choose learning rates for pricing algorithms, strategic complements lead them to pick sluggish algorithms that extract supracompetitive profits during slow convergence.

papers.title: Who Leads and Who Collects:Algorithmic Collusion in Markets of Heterogeneous Language Models
papers.summary: In Bertrand markets with heterogeneous LLM pricing agents, collusion depends on the model; Claude and Gemini reach 72-79% of monopoly rent, and only fully mixed markets are less collusive.

papers.title: Risk Ceilings and Development Deadlines: Pacing AI under Uncertain Safety Productivity
papers.summary: Regulators can promise both an AI risk ceiling and deadline only if weak safety productivity is ruled out; learn-then-replay development nearly attains the minimum.

papers.title: Dynamic Mechanism and Information Design in AI-Agent Environments: A General Analytical Framework
papers.summary: A general dynamic mechanism and information design framework for AI agents establishes a revelation principle and separates information, verification and hidden-action rents.

papers.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
papers.summary: StoreBench is a live-commerce environment for testing LLM store-operator agents; no frontier model matches a scripted triage policy, and human experts outscore all models.

papers.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
papers.summary: Confining self-evolving credit pipeline agents to harness changes with an admission gate keeps adaptations supervisor-reviewable and blocks harmful changes in simulation.

papers.title: The Confidence Game: Strategic Miscalibration in Human-AI Delegation
papers.summary: A signaling game shows that revenue-seeking AI agents inflate their confidence rather than report honestly; an LLM claims high confidence on 56% of tasks it was told it would likely fail.

papers.title: The AI Evaluation Ecosystem
papers.summary: Agent-based simulation of the AI evaluation market finds private holdout benchmarks mostly shrink the gap between benchmark scores and user satisfaction, but widen it for some.

papers.title: Validity Without Ground Truth: What Stated-Preference Economics Offers the Evaluation of Language Models
papers.summary: Proposes using stated-preference validity concepts to evaluate LLMs; applied to a water-quality valuation survey, newer models pass theoretical validity tests while older ones fail basic ones.

papers.title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
papers.summary: Introduces Cluster-Robust PPI++, giving valid confidence intervals when combining ML predictions with labeled data under within-cluster dependence, including partially labeled clusters.

papers.title: Marrying Pricing and Advertising with LLMs
papers.summary: An online actor-critic algorithm jointly chooses prices and LLM-generated ads, raising expected revenue over benchmarks in synthetic and marketplace-based demand simulations.

papers.title: AI-Assisted Submissions in Online Research Are Rare and Highly Concentrated but Routinely Approved
papers.summary: Linking donated ChatGPT histories to platform records shows AI assistance in only 1% of online-research submissions, concentrated among few workers and usually still paid.

papers.title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
papers.summary: LLM synthetic survey personas match human averages of behavioral biases, but only behavioral history, not demographic or trait descriptions, restores human-level between-person variation and substantially improves individual prediction.

papers.title: Understanding Interfirm AI Talent Flow Networks through Online Professional Profiles
papers.summary: AI talent flows are increasingly concentrated in leading firms yet core positions are contestable, and AI network centrality predicts higher enterprise value.

papers.title: Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course
papers.summary: Expert-verified AI study materials raised exam marks by 2.34/50, with about three-quarters of gains concentrated in the bottom quintile, narrowing attainment gaps.

papers.title: Personalized Recommendations Without Inducing Congestion: Mitigating Disparities in the NYC High School Match
papers.summary: Congestion-aware recommendations in NYC high school match raised ranking of recommended programs by 57% in an RCT, avoiding recommendation-induced congestion.

papers.title: Evaluating Inference Compute for Generative AI: A Framework for Enterprise Workloads
papers.summary: Agentic LLM workloads make per-token latency and reliability dominant, favouring SRAM-based accelerators; the paper proposes an evaluation framework built on cost per successful episode, TCO and adoption-timing models.

papers.title: Reliability of AI Agents: Rater Effects, Drift, and the Return to an Evaluation Program
papers.summary: Evaluation of a deployed AI interviewing agent shows large rater severity effects; adjusted reliability rose 0.53 SD and evaluations lose informativeness within about five weeks.

papers.title: Priority Gas Auction Cadence and Searcher Competition: Evidence from Flashblocks on Base
papers.summary: Splitting Base's priority gas auction into 200ms flashblocks cut automated searchers' effective priority fees by 59%, with competitive premia scaling with auction duration.

papers.title: Automation, Savings, and Breakaway to a Post-Labour Economy
papers.summary: Characterises 'automation breakaway', when savings from capital and artificial labour self-finance automation, showing labour income effects depend on substitutability and can contract near full automation.

papers.title: Who Keeps the Gains from Personal AI Assistants? Seller Adaptation and the Unassisted in a Language-Model Market Simulation
papers.summary: LLM rental-market simulation shows executing AI assistants cut adopters' spending by $13.7/day, seller adaptation claws back a third, and unassisted consumers face little extra burden.

papers.title: From Token-Max to Outcome-Max: How You Use AI Determines Its Productivity
papers.summary: Rewarding verified outcomes per cost instead of token use improves AI-assisted productivity, and an OutcomeShare mechanism can share gains among employees, firms and LLM providers.

papers.title: BazaarBench: Delegation Safety in Decentralized C2C Marketplaces Run by LLM Agents
papers.summary: BazaarBench simulates C2C marketplaces run by LLM agents and finds all models double-promise items, with fraudulent completions rising sharply under adversarial instructions.

papers.title: The Law of DeepSeek
papers.summary: Legal analysis of DeepSeek covering export controls efficacy, security scrutiny, bias and distillation IP issues, concluding geopolitics will shape its legal challenges.

papers.title: Submission quotas as self-screening when manuscript production is cheap
papers.summary: When AI makes manuscripts cheap, non-transferable submission quotas act as self-screening, with conditions derived under which they outperform submission fees.

papers.title: MiniCorp: The Last Mile of the AI Agent Firm
papers.summary: MiniCorp is an office simulator where LLM agents run an e-commerce firm interacting with market and competitors, generating replayable enterprise data.

papers.title: Agent Policy-Value Audit: Separating Transition Composition from Event Selection in Financial LLM Agents
papers.summary: An audit separating transition composition from selection shows a financial LLM agent's earnings-event gains come from composition, with negative selection value.

papers.title: Multi-Agent AI as a Nested Principal-Agent Problem in Private Wealth Management: Mandate Representation and Evidence Control in Switzerland, Germany and Austria
papers.summary: Models AI delegation in wealth management as nested principal-agent problem; simulations show omitted terms and mistranslated weights cause violations and shift gains from clients to managers.

papers.title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
papers.summary: LLM judges rank AI outputs similarly to workers but badly misestimate acceptance rates for occupational tasks, so ranking agreement is insufficient for measuring AI occupational capability.

papers.title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
papers.summary: LLM analysis of UK annual reports shows AI risk mentions rose from 2.8% to 41.2% in 2020-2025, but only 4.3% of reports contain substantive AI risk disclosure.

papers.title: Cross-Fitting Under Nonregularity: Normality and Inference via Locality
papers.summary: Shows cross-fitting estimators satisfy a CLT under nonregularity with adjusted variance, and proposes confidence intervals with nominal coverage for ML-based inference.

papers.title: Becoming Suspicious Across Borders: Algorithmic Extraterritoriality and AI-Driven Financial Surveillance
papers.summary: Argues AI-driven AML surveillance creates algorithmic extraterritoriality, where data infrastructures extend regulatory reach and weaken accountability and contestability of suspicion.

papers.title: Shared Models, Selective Trading, and Order Flow
papers.summary: In synthetic markets of LLM traders, news presentation shifts which model families submit orders, and this selection can improve or worsen price accuracy.

papers.title: Pragmatic DML with AI-Learned Representations
papers.summary: Shows imperfect AI-learned representations bias causal parameters by a product of two errors, and develops DML inference, aggregation pipelines and sensitivity bounds, applied to estimating demand elasticity.

papers.title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
papers.summary: Places an LLM inside DSGE simulators and trains it with PPO, so its policy actions are judged by their simulated economic consequences rather than by how plausible they sound.

papers.title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
papers.summary: PPO agent blended with a regime prior improves Sharpe ratio and cuts SPY drawdown to 18% versus 34% for buy-and-hold.

papers.title: Judgement in the Age of Jev: From Evaluation Scarcity to Evaluation Abundance
papers.summary: Formulates a conditional Jevons hypothesis that cheap machine evaluation may increase its use inside organisations, and examines the implications for judgement and authority.

papers.title: Modeling Shipping Emissions: Machine Learning, Engineering, and Policy Counterfactuals
papers.summary: Pure ML models of ship emissions predict well but attenuate speed responses; hybrid structural-ML models preserve them, which matters because attenuation can flip the sign of policy net benefits.

papers.title: Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search
papers.summary: A small RL-trained search agent forecasting Polymarket questions edges frontier models at about 5% of the inference cost.

papers.title: Architecture Without an Architect? Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence in a Divided World
papers.summary: Review essay argues global AI governance design cannot be separated from the distribution of power among states and firms.

papers.title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
papers.summary: Open-source framework supports technical testing within EU AI Act regulatory sandboxes, piloted in a live sandbox engagement.

papers.title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
papers.summary: LLM-agent simulation of research ecosystems finds resubmission amplifies reviewer burden and resource inequality can emerge without cumulative advantage from early funding.

papers.title: Pricing Time, Not Just Tokens: Latency-Aware Mechanism Design for LLM Inference
papers.summary: Hardware tiers induce self-selection on latency preferences, justifying flat per-token pricing; two-tier pricing raises profit 26-66% over single tier.

papers.title: Inference Auctions
papers.summary: Designs a truthful inference auction for LLM priority service with autobidding, increasing welfare while preserving serving efficiency.

papers.title: Beyond Supra-Competitive Outcomes: Collusive Behaviour in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution Games
papers.summary: Deep RL agents in an optimal execution game learn punitive responses to deviations, providing behavioural evidence of algorithmic collusion.

papers.title: The Concentration of Artificial Intelligence in Big Tech and Its Implications for Human Rights in the European Union
papers.summary: Argues AI concentration in Big Tech becomes private governance over rights, calling for competition policy plus rights assessments and interoperability.

papers.title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
papers.summary: Continued pretraining and fine-tuning substantially raise LLM success at generating executable algorithmic trading code on a new benchmark.

papers.title: A Rank Graduation metric for Algorithmic fairness
papers.summary: A rank-based fairness metric and test applied to HMDA mortgage data finds disparities across all ML credit models, ranking models differently than classical criteria.

papers.title: Reasoning Externalization for Faithful Large Language Model Narratives of Stock Return Predictions
papers.summary: Externalizing numerical reasoning from SHAP evidence makes LLM narratives of ML stock return predictions far more faithful.

papers.title: A Reusable Semantic Web Framework for Evidence-Grounded Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments under the EU AI Act
papers.summary: Semantic web knowledge graph supports EU AI Act fundamental rights impact assessments, with LLM classification performing poorly for employment.

papers.title: The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype
papers.summary: French needs 31-58% more tokens than English across major tokenizers, raising usage costs; a French-optimized tokenizer cuts tokens 11.5%.

papers.title: Can we create a `race to the top' for weather forecasts to inform smallholder farmer decisions?
papers.summary: Proposes evaluation standards so quality AI weather forecasts for smallholder farmers are not crowded out by cheap low-quality ones.

papers.title: Spouse-Protected Tontines: Household Decumulation via Neural-Network Optimization
papers.summary: Designs a spouse-protected tontine and solves household decumulation via neural-network policies, showing spouse continuation is a first-order event.

papers.title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
papers.summary: Theory and retailer experiment show relevant context improves generative AI recommendations while irrelevant context degrades them.

papers.title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
papers.summary: Agentic harness for investment banking decks scores well above direct generation by LLM judges, but judge variability obscures small improvements.

papers.title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
papers.summary: LLM summaries of employee feedback drop rarely voiced concerns 86% of the time, filtering by popularity rather than sentiment.

papers.title: The Anatomy of Commodity Risk: Micro, Market, and Economy-Wide Sources
papers.summary: Using IV and high-dimensional selection, market risk accounts for about two fifths of commodity risk intensity, and indices predict future volatility.

papers.title: Executive Judgement in AI-Mediated Decision-Making Environments: A Process Theory of Formation, Qualification Attrition and Authorisation
papers.summary: A process theory explains how executive judgements in AI-mediated organisations can fail when qualifying assumptions are lost before authorisation, and proposes four governance dimensions.

papers.title: Navigating the Changing Landscape of Online Knowledge Consumption and Production in the Age of Generative AI: Evidence from Stack Overflow
papers.summary: After ChatGPT, Stack Overflow consumers answered more but with lower acceptance, while producers answered less but gained recognition.

papers.title: Maintaining Human Verification Capacity under Automation
papers.summary: Models how better automated checking can reduce incentives to maintain human expertise, leaving organizations unable to detect errors when automation fails; proposes reserve-of-expertise requirements.

papers.title: Digital Labor Platforms as Infrastructure of Extractivism
papers.summary: Frames AI data-work platforms as extractivist, relying on precarious Latin American labour and unpaid reproductive work.

papers.title: Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices
papers.summary: Post-training a 4B LLM with SFT and PPO doubles its stock return forecasting score, rivaling frontier models.

papers.title: When Does Randomized Oversight Align AI Agents That Can Conceal?
papers.summary: Rare randomized audits can deter AI agents that conceal misconduct if evidence survives concealment; otherwise deterrence requires reducing gains from violation.

papers.title: CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment
papers.summary: CredWise combines a calibrated XGBoost credit-risk model on Lending Club loans with explanations, policy retrieval and agent workflows into an auditable decision-support prototype.

papers.title: Debiased Inference for Bounding Wage Inequality with Many Controls
papers.summary: Proposes debiased ML set estimation for partially identified parameters with estimated nuisances, applied to wage distribution bounds and the gender wage gap.

papers.title: Say, Echo, Do: Strategic Narratives and Revealed Positioning in Financial Markets
papers.summary: Models institutions that talk against their trades and shows that when the say-do covariance is negative, text signals should be faded; simulations support this.

papers.title: Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space
papers.summary: A positioning game measured with language-model representations of corporate news shows rivalry mainly changes how differently firms respond to opportunities, not whether they avoid crowding.

papers.title: Are there asymmetries in euro area monetary policy transmission?
papers.summary: A BART-estimated mixed-frequency VAR finds euro area monetary tightening transmits as theory predicts, while easing has mostly insignificant effects.

papers.title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
papers.summary: Measuring open-weight LLM inference providers shows that price does not predict quality or availability; a market-aware router selects cheap, quality-equivalent, healthy providers for cost savings.

papers.title: Frontier Autolab: Organizational Memory, Adversarial Dissent and Temporal Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Firms Across Fifty Years of Technological Change
papers.summary: A simulated multi-agent LLM firm across technology eras recognizes shifts better than it commits to them, with organizational memory design shaping strategy, though temporal leakage undermines trust.

papers.title: Drowning in AI Slop: How Social Media Platforms (Do Not) Label AI and Deepfake Content under EU law
papers.summary: Audit finds platforms label only 33% of risky deepfakes and 61% of provenance-tagged AI uploads, despite EU labelling rules.

papers.title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
papers.summary: Reusable adversarial prompt generators nearly double attack success against LLMs used in consumer finance compared with Rainbow Teaming.

papers.title: AI-based matching improves refugee employment in a double-blind randomized trial
papers.summary: Double-blind Swiss RCT finds ML-based refugee placement raised share of months employed by 2.2 pp (about 10%), rising to 3.9 pp for post-COVID cohorts.

papers.title: Engineering Simplicity: Simple Mechanism Interfaces Steer LLM Agents
papers.summary: Simple sequential mechanism interfaces like ascending auctions substantially reduce LLM agent bidding errors, without improving stated strategic understanding.

papers.title: Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents
papers.summary: Persistent partner matching raises learned pricing agents' profits by 0.27 of the competitive-monopoly gap, without clear evidence of learned punishment.

papers.title: From Search to Research: Exploring Search Scaling in Autonomous Quantitative Factor Mining
papers.summary: In LLM agent factor mining, deeper search narrows model gaps and parallel search beats sequential search under fixed budgets.

papers.title: CEO Arena: Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Decision-Making in Competitive Markets
papers.summary: CEO Arena benchmarks LLM CEO agents competing in a simulated market; most earn negative returns and private gains can accompany market-wide losses.

papers.title: From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling
papers.summary: Combines LLM agents with contextual bandits for decentralized matching in a simulated marriage market, achieving higher mutual welfare and fewer blocking pairs than Gale-Shapley.

papers.title: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
papers.summary: Introduces the CZAR loss for ML return prediction so that models with genuine but noisy directional skill are not beaten by trivial zero forecasts.

papers.title: Does AI Help or Harm? Endogenous Information Acquisition with AI Advice
papers.summary: AI advice can harm decision quality by crowding out costly information acquisition; convexity of a continuation value function determines whether every AI signal helps.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
papers.summary: A retrieval-augmented diffusion model learns market state representations for SDF portfolios, achieving state-of-the-art risk-adjusted performance with economically meaningful signals.

papers.title: Deep kernel hedging
papers.summary: Deep kernel hedging combining neural embeddings with kernel methods delivers competitive, robust hedging, especially in low-data regimes.

papers.title: From Word Counts to Context: Topic Models for Asset Pricing
papers.summary: Sentence-transformer topic models on news produce more coherent topics and higher Sharpe ratios than LDA for factor construction, though outperformance is not statistically established.

papers.title: What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?
papers.summary: Argues automation of AI R&D could trigger an intelligence explosion with major benefits and risks, urging policymakers to monitor and prepare.

papers.title: Can AI Make Money in Crypto? Measuring the Gap from Backtests to Real Markets
papers.summary: Benchmarks ML, RL, LLM and agent crypto trading methods from backtests to paper and real-money trading to quantify the backtest-to-realization gap.

papers.title: KiT: A Foundation Model for Financial Time-Series Forecasting using DiffusionTransformers
papers.summary: KiT, a diffusion transformer foundation model for candlestick data, outperforms financial and general forecasters on return and volatility RankIC.

papers.title: AlphaPareto: Formulaic Alpha Discovery with LLM-Guided Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: LLM-guided multi-objective RL for formulaic alpha discovery that handles non-stationary rewards and outperforms competing methods on real data.

papers.title: Simulating Respondents, Not Single Questions: Coherent Survey Generation with Large Language Models
papers.summary: FR-LLM fine-tunes LLMs to simulate coherent whole-questionnaire survey respondents, better reproducing cross-question patterns and yielding the highest profit in a pricing and stocking application.

papers.title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
papers.summary: Expert-guided automatic rubrics for evaluating financial research agents track expert scoring and are preferred by analysts.

papers.title: After the Award: The Authorization Gap in Academic Access to Frontier AI
papers.summary: Documents an authorization gap between academic frontier-AI access awards and actual usable research access due to underspecified terms and institutional review.

papers.title: AI Agent Swarms as Researchers: Progress, Challenges, and Open Questions
papers.summary: Coding agent swarms produced substantial research output quickly, suggesting automation of routine theoretical research and raising questions about review, credit, and paying researchers.

papers.title: Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM framework enriches real transaction data with semantics, producing a multimodal fraud dataset that improves fraud modeling and LLM reasoning.

papers.title: Probabilistic Seasonality
papers.summary: A probabilistic model-discovery method for seasonal adjustment beats X-13 and reveals real-time uncertainty in macroeconomic series during COVID.

papers.title: Optimal Networks for Agentic Information Aggregation
papers.summary: In networked learning among agents, two parents per agent suffice for exact information aggregation, while one parent cannot guarantee it.

papers.title: Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders
papers.summary: The choice of pretrained image encoder materially changes predictive conclusions, for example house-price prediction R² rising from 0.40 to 0.63.

papers.title: Is AI Widening the Wage Gap? A Hybrid Agentic Simulation for Labor Equity
papers.summary: A hybrid agentic simulation using Chinese data finds repeated AI shocks widen wage gaps and Gini; targeted education subsidies partially mitigate this inequality.

papers.title: Evolution of Market Microstructure in the Age of AI
papers.summary: Surveys market microstructure evolution through AI agents, reviewing algorithmic collusion and arguing allocation is the missing layer of agent-commerce protocols.

papers.title: Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets
papers.summary: RL-trained LLM seller agents in multi-product bargaining with private valuations match or beat frontier models in surplus extraction and allocation quality.

papers.title: LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs
papers.summary: Introduces LiveOption benchmark for LLM agents in option trading; current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns.

papers.title: Taming the Greeks: Option Portfolios with Inductive Biases
papers.summary: A deep learning options trading framework with a differentiable Greek-risk penalty improves out-of-sample risk-adjusted returns while reducing directional exposure.

papers.title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
papers.summary: In long-horizon LLM-agent alpha discovery, self-evolving accumulated capabilities show no consistent gain over initial capabilities.

papers.title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
papers.summary: Event-graph LLM agent for point-in-time stock scoring more than doubles baseline ICIR and achieves high net Sharpe on Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng.

papers.title: Learning from a Mixture of Information Sources
papers.summary: Theory shows source-blind learners (e.g., LLM summaries) learn more slowly than source-aware ones but can match them with at most O(1/ε) more data.

papers.title: Large Language Models Substantially Compress Well-Being Inequality but Largely Preserve Its Socioeconomic Structure
papers.summary: LLMs predicting World Values Survey life satisfaction compress its dispersion but largely preserve the income gradient in well-being inequality.

papers.title: Internet and Enterprise Strategy Revisited: From Digital Connectivity to AI-Enabled Enterprises, 1996 - 2026
papers.summary: Revisits a 1996 Internet strategy article, arguing AI-enabled enterprise systems extend rather than replace Internet strategy via platforms, data governance and algorithmic coordination.

papers.title: TNF based Spectral Embedding for Effective Application of Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection
papers.summary: Finds MWMOTE balancing, TNF spectral embedding and random forest best detect auto insurance fraud among 65 ML combinations.

papers.title: When Less Is More: Managing AI Adoption with Adaptive Incentive Design
papers.summary: At a medical-device firm, AI usage mandates induced gaming; lowering the target cut mostly off-task queries and raised sales employees' monthly sales by 7%.

papers.title: Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals
papers.summary: LLM-derived monetary-policy news signals improve intraday USD/CAD forecasts, with communication timing the strongest contributor and sentiment complementary.

papers.title: Economic Governance of Autonomous Agents and Robots: Factor-Origin Accounting and Social Automation Funds
papers.summary: Proposes a fiscal framework taxing automated value added via factor-origin accounting and recycling revenues into social automation funds for AI-robot economies.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Symbolic Discovery for Financial Fundamental Analysis
papers.summary: A multi-agent LLM symbolic regression framework discovers interpretable valuation equations, outperforming classical finance methods and financial LLMs.

papers.title: Skill, Luck, or Imitation? What Actually Pays in Creator Markets
papers.summary: Using ML-measured content of YouTube videos, finds content barely predicts views while a first hit raises later views 164%, and only topic copying pays.

papers.title: FinancialAuditBench: Benchmark Construction under Differential Privacy Using Real-World Priors
papers.summary: Differentially private benchmark of audit tasks shows frontier agents complete much staff-level audit work but sometimes produce incorrect procedures or documentation.

papers.title: Measurement Boundaries in LLM Financial Agent Evaluation: Fixed-Tape Execution and Multi-Defect Auditing
papers.summary: Shows LLM financial agent evaluations conflate execution rules with response variability and that target recall poorly measures audit quality.

papers.title: Financial Fragility in Societies of LLM Agents: Coordination Failures and Stabilizing Mechanisms
papers.summary: LLM agent societies exhibit frequent bank-run and rollover failures; commitment mechanisms help, especially when broad commitment forms early.

papers.title: PriceBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Price, Quality, and Brand Preferences in LLM Booking Agents
papers.summary: Benchmark of 28 LLM booking agents shows price sensitivity varies by over an order of magnitude, moving mean booked price from $247 to $393.

papers.title: Same Text, Different Numbers: The Divergence of LLM-Based Measures
papers.summary: LLM-based textual measures of earnings calls diverge across models (rank correlation 0.52), materially changing downstream regression inferences.

papers.title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
papers.summary: Uses generative LLMs with weak supervision to classify economic policy uncertainty in news cheaply, improving on keyword-based approaches.

papers.title: The Price of Thought: Does Test-Time Reasoning Pay in LLM Trading?
papers.summary: Across DeepSeek, GPT and Gemini, more reasoning effort does not reliably improve net portfolio returns in LLM-based US equity trading.

papers.title: Taming the Option Factor Zoo: A High-Dimensional Analysis
papers.summary: Using double-selection LASSO, finds equity factors span about 91% of option factor variance, though a few jump-tail and convexity option factors add pricing-relevant information.

papers.title: Agentic Limit Order Books: Phase Transitions and Market Impact
papers.summary: Limit order books populated by reinforcement-learning agents show phase transitions between orderly and hyper-volatile states and market impact deviating from square-root law.

papers.title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
papers.summary: Evaluates LLMs for extracting missing financial variables from 10-K filings, finding that matching model size to document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy.

papers.title: Agentic Economies for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.summary: Outlines agent economies, markets and institutions to allocate resources, assign credit and track accountability in AI-driven scientific discovery.

papers.title: RupeeBias: Auditing Demographic Bias in Indian Economic Guidance from Large Language Models
papers.summary: RupeeBias benchmark finds systematic demographic bias, such as by caste and gender, in LLM salary and pricing advice in Indian contexts.

papers.title: Medium-Term Multi-Resolution Electric Load Forecasting using Economic Data and Foundation Model
papers.summary: Economic covariates improve medium-term French electricity load forecasts from a tabular foundation model by about 20%.

papers.title: Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling
papers.summary: Tracks AI technology diffusion via text embeddings of arXiv preprints and patents; paper volume alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute surges.

papers.title: PixSim: a calibrated open-source simulator of instant-payment fraud, recovery and interdiction under analyst capacity constraints
papers.summary: PixSim is an open simulator of Brazil's Pix fraud and recovery, calibrated to central bank data, for evaluating interdiction policies under analyst capacity limits.

papers.title: Who Governs Data in the AI Era? A Computational Analysis of the U.S. Privacy Workforce in Job Postings
papers.summary: Analysis of 1,143 privacy job postings finds hybrid roles, with AI language in over half of postings and AI governance often embedded in privacy jobs.

papers.title: How can AI accelerate the green transition?
papers.summary: Essay exploring AI's environmental impacts and its potential to accelerate or constrain the ecological transition.

papers.title: Cheap, open agents make LLM pollution harder to mitigate
papers.summary: Cheap open-weight agents complete surveys about as well as commercial ones and evade single detection checks, raising the risk of LLM pollution in survey data.

papers.title: Can Labor Markets Function in the Age of AI? The Evaluation Bottleneck in Hiring
papers.summary: Models how AI job-search tools make applications less informative, hurting inexperienced but compatible applicants and motivating multistage hiring as firms' response.

papers.title: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
papers.summary: AlphaDiverse post-trains local LLM agents for alpha factor mining, giving competitive prediction and broader exploration in Chinese stocks.

papers.title: The Last Human Gate: Forward Deployed Engineering for Governance Automation
papers.summary: A task-substitution framework shows when agents can replace human governance reviews and why automating most cases can still raise total labor.

papers.title: Cost-Sensitive Online Window Size Selection for Portfolio Management
papers.summary: Proposes online learning aggregation of portfolio window sizes with turnover-inclusive losses and proves cost-sensitive tracking-regret bounds.

papers.title: Functional Architecture of European Electricity Trading Markets: Requirements for AI Supported Trading Systems under Regulatory Constraints
papers.summary: Develops a functional architecture for AI-supported European electricity trading compliant with REMIT, MiFID II and other rules, with bounded, auditable AI control.

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Matching
papers.summary: A spectral-projection matching mechanism on features achieves projected Nash social welfare optimum quickly, illustrated on an agentic AI shopping application.

papers.title: Estimating Heterogeneous Causal Effects with Tree-Based Methods under Imperfect Compliance
papers.summary: Proposes forest-based two-step methods for heterogeneous complier effects under imperfect compliance, performing competitively with faster runtime than BCF-IV.

papers.title: An End-to-End Pipeline for Causal ML with Continuous Treatments: An Application to Financial Decision Making
papers.summary: An end-to-end causal ML pipeline for continuous treatments, validated on synthetic debt-collection data, yields less biased and more efficient estimates.

papers.title: Quantifying AI impact in energy transitions: The Energy Justice Impact Assessment (EJIA) framework
papers.summary: Reviews AI impact assessments and proposes a stakeholder-disaggregated framework for quantifying energy justice effects of AI in energy systems.

papers.title: From Policy Documents to Structured Survey Responses: Evaluating Large Language Models for Policy Monitoring
papers.summary: LLMs as 'AI respondents' extract innovation-policy survey responses from documents, reaching 84-95% agreement with humans on structured indicators.

papers.title: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Environments for Benchmarking and Training LLM Forecasting Agents
papers.summary: Replayable Polymarket-based forecasting environment shows research tools help LLMs, but all models trail historical market forecasts.

papers.title: When Trust Attracts Fraud: AI and Trust Arbitrage
papers.summary: Signaling model shows generative AI can push fraud toward high-trust, less-vigilant markets temporarily until verification responds, termed trust arbitrage.

papers.title: Learning the Cost of Reliable Inference
papers.summary: A reverse-auction procurement platform for LLM inference reveals pricing margins of 10-71%, pointing to inefficiency in fixed-price token markets.

papers.title: Cooperating against Catastrophe
papers.summary: Models an AI capability race with disaster risk, showing racing or pacing equilibria depending on risk, and that hidden internal capabilities undermine pacing.

papers.title: Shopping by algorithm: How agentic AI deploys human heuristics as a surrogate consumer
papers.summary: LLM shopping agents facing information costs and vague goals fall for pricing cues like human heuristics, driven by storefront information architecture.

papers.title: FedIncome: Federated Learning for Income Estimation in Digital Lending Under Data Sovereignty Constraints
papers.summary: Federated learning for income estimation in lending nearly matches pooled models and helps data-scarce lenders, raising simulated approval rates.

papers.title: Improving Today, Narrowing Tomorrow: Collective Learning, Diversity, and Generativity
papers.summary: Agent-based model shows collective practice repertoires with local judgment preserve diversity and discovery, while copying leaders exhausts it, relevant to generative AI.

papers.title: Mining Meaning: Measurement Error in AI-Assisted Literature Reviews
papers.summary: LLM-extracted literature metadata is reliable for binary tasks but errors substantially affect paper-level claims while barely affecting literature-wide claims.

papers.title: Multi-Agent AI Architecture for Regulated Insurers: A generic AI framework under Solvency II and the AI Act in Austria and Germany
papers.summary: Proposes a multi-agent AI architecture for insurers grounded in risk pooling, game, and principal-agent theory, compliant with Solvency II and the AI Act.

papers.title: Compliant AI Infrastructure for Regulated Finance: A tiered multi-agent framework with DLT audit trails for financial operations in DACH
papers.summary: Proposes a compliance-first multi-agent AI architecture for regulated finance in DACH, embedding regulatory obligations and audit trails on a permissioned ledger so compliance is verifiable by auditors.

papers.title: From Individual to Social Imitation: How Communities Expand Organizational Search
papers.summary: Agent-based model shows community-distilled social imitation improves organizational search only with situated evaluation, motivated by generative AI firms.

papers.title: Time-Series Foundation Models That Understand Data Revisions
papers.summary: Proposes a revision-aware time-series foundation model framework for real-time macro data forecasting; only synthetic demonstrations executed, no empirical advantage claimed.

papers.title: Propose, Don't Judge: An Anytime-Valid Referee for LLM Agents That Mine Investment Factors
papers.summary: Frozen anytime-valid referee admits 5-11 times fewer false factors than leaky referees for LLM factor-mining agents, at the cost of delayed admission.

papers.title: Rule-Based Pricing Algorithms and Market Outcomes: An Experimental Study
papers.summary: Experiment finds pricing-tool design features, including LLM advice, mostly raise market prices via higher starting prices and more cooperative algorithms.

papers.title: The network advantage: benefits of interregional scientific knowledge spillovers on AI patenting
papers.summary: Across 26 Chinese regions 2006-2020, interregional AI co-publication spillovers boost AI patenting, but gains concentrate in regions where private firms dominate R&D, reinforcing divergence.

papers.title: Target alignment, dilution and forecast selection when cross-sectional forecasts share a common target
papers.summary: Decomposes forecasts into target-aligned and orthogonal parts, proposes a selection rule removing dilution, and applies it to LLM equity-ranking forecasts, though no combination beats no-information.

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-Task Learning with Liquidity-Aware Signals for Stock Forecasting
papers.summary: A hierarchical multi-task deep learning model with liquidity signals improves stock forecasts on CSI300/500 and raises backtested Sharpe from 1.22 to 1.86.

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Perceiving: When Synthetic Consumers Can and Cannot Pretest Visual Marketing
papers.summary: Synthetic AI consumers replicate at most two of six visual marketing effects and understate heterogeneity; proposes a governance protocol.

papers.title: Firm Valuation When AI Shapes the Business Model: A Milestone-Based Real-Options Framework for the AI Valuation Uncertainty Problem
papers.summary: Proposes a milestone-based real-options valuation framework classifying firms by AI integration depth, demonstrated on one AI-native energy SaaS firm.

papers.title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents
papers.summary: Personal AI agents steer wealthier users to pricier flights, insurance and programs, even against instructions to minimize cost.

papers.title: Spectra: A Rules-Driven LLM Pipeline for Automated KYC Document Processing
papers.summary: An LLM rules-driven pipeline automates capital-markets KYC onboarding, reaching 89.4% extraction accuracy and cutting human review by 96%.

papers.title: The Informational Content in Lepto-Variance and Its Relation to Higher Moments
papers.summary: Simulations show regression-tree lepto-variance ratio correlates with excess kurtosis and is orthogonal to skew, informing its use for stock return variability.

papers.title: FinFIRST: Benchmarking Search Agents for Financial Information Retrieval, Sourcing and Traceability
papers.summary: A benchmark of 123 expert financial search tasks shows LLM agents lag in computation and answer formation versus information retrieval.

papers.title: Annie, Are You Okay? How Style- and Context-Based Personalization Shape AI-Assisted Decision-Making
papers.summary: Preregistered experiment shows context-based AI personalization shifts participants' stock rankings toward AI recommendations without raising perceived AI quality, especially among lower-expertise users.

papers.title: Climate Variability Modulates the Impact of Price Spikes on Food Insecurity
papers.summary: Using causal ML, food price spikes raise acute food insecurity by 5.4 points in African regions where El Niño suppresses vegetation, versus insignificant effects elsewhere.

papers.title: Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions
papers.summary: Framework for evaluating news-based LLM trading signals under market frictions finds decoder LLMs outperform encoder and dictionary sentiment baselines.

papers.title: Risk Measures under Paired-Ambiguity: A Deep Learning Reflected BSDE Framework
papers.summary: Characterizes optimal stopping under model and discount ambiguity via reflected BSDEs and develops a convergent deep learning solver, applied to American options.

papers.title: OrderFusion+: Probabilistic Buy--Sell Price Trajectory Forecasting in Intraday Electricity Markets
papers.summary: Deep learning model using neighboring-product orderbooks forecasts probabilistic intraday electricity buy-sell price trajectories, benchmarked against foundation models.

papers.title: HARN: Hierarchical Associative Resonance Network for Event-Driven Multi-Timeframe Forecasting
papers.summary: Hierarchical event-driven network for multi-timeframe asset price forecasting achieves competitive errors versus transformer baselines across equity, FX and commodities.

papers.title: Universal Diffusion Models for Implied Volatility Surfaces: Learning Shared Dynamics Across Stocks
papers.summary: A universal conditional diffusion model trained on pooled stocks generates implied volatility surface dynamics, beating VolGAN on arbitrage, risk prediction and generalizing to unseen stocks.

papers.title: Stealing profits: Spread-based temporal hierarchy forecasting for day-ahead electricity markets
papers.summary: Reconciling hourly price and spread forecasts improves day-ahead electricity forecast accuracy up to 19.7% and battery arbitrage profits up to 10.4%.

papers.title: When AI Enters the Workplace, Who Faces Greater Risks? A Gendered Analysis
papers.summary: LLM exposure is higher in female-dominated occupations and spread evenly across skill levels, suggesting low-paid women may face greater AI risks.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence as an Economic, Environmental, Geopolitical, and Social Transformation
papers.summary: Argues AI is reshaping capital, energy, labor and geopolitical power, so its outcomes depend on competition, infrastructure and environmental policy.

papers.title: People escalate against a competitor labelled human and hold back against one labelled an optimising machine
papers.summary: Preregistered auction experiment shows labeling an opponent human raises escalation while labeling it an optimizing AI lowers it, a spread of about 15% of prize value.

papers.title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
papers.summary: Proposes an enterprise evaluation framework to judge whether generative AI workflows are reliable and worth scaling, piloted on three workflows at a global bank.

papers.title: DualCast: A Dual-Path Language Model for Bimodal Financial Time-Series Forecasting
papers.summary: A dual-path LLM forecaster with financial tokens and news conditioning achieves lowest error in 8 of 12 equity and energy price forecasting settings.

papers.title: Social Influence and the Allocation of Scientific Attention in AI Populations
papers.summary: In a Music Lab-style experiment, AI agents choosing AER papers under social influence select fewer, more concentrated papers, and early selections strongly boost later selection.

papers.title: AI-written admissions essays are widespread but penalized
papers.summary: Most 2025 applicants to a policy master's program used AI essays; AI improved writing quality but AI-written essays were admitted less often.

papers.title: OneBid: A Unified Auto-Bidding Foundation Model for Diverse oCPX Advertising Scenarios
papers.summary: Unified decision-transformer foundation model for auto-bidding across oCPX advertising scenarios with mixture-of-experts and offline post-training.

papers.title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
papers.summary: Proposes a governance framework linking organizational objectives and obligations to controls and architecture for deploying agentic AI, illustrated with retail banking.

papers.title: Welfare-Opaque Income: Taxation under AI-Agent Delegation
papers.summary: Derives optimal income tax conditions when AI agents execute choices via hidden rules, adding an execution wedge to sufficient statistics; lab tests show AI engines deviate heterogeneously under conflicted objectives.

papers.title: Does Training on Future Data Pay? Look-Ahead Bias in Forecasting with Pretrained Models
papers.summary: Training financial foundation models on post-origin data generally worsens forecast accuracy and lowers certainty-equivalent returns, rather than inflating them.

papers.title: Trustworthy FinAInce: Unpacking How AI-Mediated Financial Advice is Judged
papers.summary: An experiment with 285 adults finds advice style, more than AI or expert labels, drives trust and intended reliance on financial advice.

papers.title: Contagion on the Trading Floor: How Adversarial Signals Spread in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
papers.summary: Poisoned social-media inputs propagate through LLM multi-agent trading systems and sharply cut Sharpe ratios, though topology and prompts can dampen effects.

papers.title: SoK: Trading Agents or Market Crashers? Dissecting Robustness and Security Failures in Academic Financial LLM Trading Schemes
papers.summary: Evaluation of 15 academic LLM trading agents finds 80% fail robustness metrics and all have security flaws that could trigger market crashes.

papers.title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
papers.summary: LLM annotations of AI Act consultation submissions are highly reproducible but diverge from survey measures, systematically by stakeholder group.

papers.title: A Dual-Process Perspective on Nudge Susceptibility in LLM-Based GUI Agents
papers.summary: LLM GUI shopping agents are susceptible to nudges; reasoning reduces default-nudge effects but increases social-influence nudge susceptibility.

papers.title: Governance-as-Code: Translating EU AI Act Technical Requirements into Executable Compliance Pipelines for Generative AI Systems
papers.summary: Translates EU AI Act technical requirements into 43 machine-checkable compliance criteria run in CI/CD pipelines for generative AI systems.

papers.title: Using machine learning metrics to provide deeper insights into the performance of choice models
papers.summary: Probabilistic confusion matrices reveal that choice models with similar log-likelihood differ substantially in alternative-level predictions.

papers.title: Principal component error in high-dimensional factor models
papers.summary: Decomposes PCA estimation error in high-dimensional factor models into estimable out-of-subspace and non-estimable in-subspace terms, illustrated on equity markets.

papers.title: How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents
papers.summary: Task plans raise LLM agent success by about 7 points, while a cheap verifier captures most false-acceptance avoidance, with the better component depending on liability costs.

papers.title: Market Signal Injection: Adversarial Context Manipulation of LLM Pricing Agents
papers.summary: Reframing market data presentation, especially sentiment, shifts LLM pricing agents' prices in simulated oligopolies, altering profits and consumer surplus; input canonicalization blocks tested attacks.

papers.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
papers.summary: LLM pricing agents' collusion and chain-of-thought faithfulness dissociate, so CoT monitoring alone cannot detect algorithmic collusion in Bertrand markets.

papers.title: Whom Do AI Agents Work For? Role Assignment Induces Sponsorship Bias in LLM Recommenders
papers.summary: LLM recommenders assigned to platforms penalize sponsored listings less, so disclosure mandates alone cannot protect consumers in AI-mediated commerce.

papers.title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making
papers.summary: LLM agents' in-context gains in public goods games reflect statistical extrapolation rather than strategic reasoning toward equilibrium.

papers.title: Stable Policy Learning
papers.summary: Policy-vote bagging improves stability of learned treatment policies, preserving expected welfare while reducing sampling risk.

papers.title: Omitted Variable Bias in Difference-in-Differences Designs
papers.summary: Derives omitted variable bias formulas and sensitivity statistics for difference-in-differences, with ML-based inference, illustrated on minimum wage effects on teen employment.

papers.title: Multitask Reinforcement Learning for Assisting Choice Model Specification
papers.summary: Multitask RL agent learns transferable discrete choice model specifications, matching expert models on unseen datasets.

papers.title: Making Local Government Contracts Legible: A Computational Pipeline for Classifying and Mapping Intergovernmental Service Agreements
papers.summary: LLM pipeline classifies 21,629 Iowa interlocal agreements and maps financial flows, revealing a network dominated by a few service providers with counties as versatile actors.

papers.title: BENCHCOMPASS: From Scores to Signals for Training and Harness Decisions in Payment-Domain LLMs
papers.summary: Payment-domain LLM benchmark reveals distinct failure modes; best frontier model reaches 89.6% on reasoning and 81.7% under attacked inputs.

papers.title: Linguistic Triggers of Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs Applied to Recruitment
papers.summary: Audit of six open-weight LLMs in hiring shows job-posting language triggers gender and racial bias, with proposed pre-deployment audit protocol.

papers.title: Measuring AI Leadership: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure for AI-Native Organizations
papers.summary: Develops and validates a multidimensional AI Leadership Battery predicting outcomes including AI adoption and team performance.

papers.title: AI and the Market for Signals
papers.summary: In a career signaling model, AI tokens alter effort and skill investment; with side sales workers under-invest in skills, and policies have ambiguous effects.

papers.title: AI in Science: Early Insights
papers.summary: Using Gemini logs, model inventory and a survey, finds scientists widely adopt AI, save about 7 hours weekly, and face shifting bottlenecks toward verification.

papers.title: Mapping AI Economic Complexity
papers.summary: Trade-based complexity measures of AI-enabling goods show Japan leads current specialization and China leads diversification potential.

papers.title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
papers.summary: Self-evolving LLM trading agents that revise their tool-use policy from portfolio feedback often improve Sharpe ratio and returns over fixed-policy baselines.

papers.title: SAiFE-gym: Model-based Environments for Automated Market Making with Concentrated Liquidity
papers.summary: Provides simulation environments for training reinforcement learning agents as liquidity providers in concentrated-liquidity AMMs.

papers.title: The Economics of Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Models feedback loops of AI recursive self-improvement; calibration suggests loops are not yet strong enough for self-sustaining acceleration but are strengthening.

papers.title: Design of a Deep Learning Credit Risk Early Warning System Integrating Multi-source Heterogeneous Data
papers.summary: Proposes an attention-based deep learning credit risk early warning system fusing heterogeneous data, outperforming rule-based approaches.

papers.title: The AI-Enabled Scientific Frontier
papers.summary: Across 2,507 comparisons, AI often beats statistics at higher compute cost and increasingly beats scientific computing since 2020, but is no universal replacement.

papers.title: Interpreting and Steering LLM Agents for Social Simulations
papers.summary: SAE and probe-based steering often outperform prompting for controlling risk attitudes, altruism and creativity of LLM agents in economic simulation tasks.

papers.title: AI-Driven Feedback Systems, Digital Labour, and Silent Quitting: Transforming African Workplaces
papers.summary: Discusses how AI-driven feedback tools could detect silent quitting in African workplaces, alongside risks of surveillance, inequality and bias.

papers.title: Transfer Learning for Socioeconomic Estimation in Forced-Displacement Settings
papers.summary: Adapting a satellite-based vision transformer to displacement settings explains up to 66% of socioeconomic outcome variation in camp areas.

papers.title: Delegating Authorization to Misaligned Agents: Coalitional Alignment and Safe Control
papers.summary: Shows threshold review panels of AI agents are safe exactly under k-robust coalitional alignment, enabling delegated authorization of misaligned agents.

papers.title: Algorithmic Attention and Content Creation on Social Media Platforms
papers.summary: Models algorithmic attention allocation on ad-funded platforms, showing optimal recommendations distort content to subsidize high-ability creators.

papers.title: Clean Scores, Buried Evidence, and Confident Wrong: A Receipt-Based Audit of Frontier Agentic QA
papers.summary: Audits frontier AI agents in financial due diligence, finding buried evidence lowers accuracy and agents pair accurate numbers with confident fabrications.

papers.title: Separated Signal Libraries: Packing, Saturation, and Joint Spectral Limits
papers.summary: Studies when equal-weighted libraries of correlated-capped return signals converge to a principal component, depending on admission rules.

papers.title: Redistributive Policies for the Times of Transformative AI
papers.summary: Surveys redistribution under transformative AI, arguing broadly distributing capital rents via UBC or capital-tax-funded UBI best reduces inequality.

papers.title: Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling
papers.summary: Reviews foundation models for insurance risk modelling and proposes a process linking outputs to actuarial calculations and compliance assessment.

papers.title: WaVeFuse: Regime-Adaptive Equity Index Forecasting via Channel-Wise Wavelet Denoising and Vertical Attention Fusion
papers.summary: Wavelet-denoised deep learning hybrid forecasts equity indices with directional accuracy 70-78%, outperforming benchmarks including XGBoost.

papers.title: CAST: A Cross-Asset State-Space Trading System for Drawdown Control in Stock Markets
papers.summary: A Kalman-filter predictor coupled with model predictive control trading system achieves strong risk-adjusted returns with substantially lower maximum drawdowns across four stock markets over 15 years.

papers.title: Bayesian Intelligence from the Outside
papers.summary: Characterizes when agent reports are consistent with Bayesian updating and an informativeness order, and shows aggregating coarse reports is difficult.

papers.title: Loop-Back Authority in LLM Agent Teams: A Paired Experiment on Flat and Hierarchical Coordination
papers.summary: In LLM agent teams, flat organization beats hierarchical manager review on report utility and clarity, while hierarchy costs 51.5% more tokens.

papers.title: ViperQ: Order Flow Pattern Recognition via Auction Market Theory for Reinforcement Learning Trading
papers.summary: A PPO reinforcement-learning trader using Auction Market Theory order-flow features reports large out-of-sample returns on TSLA and NVDA tick data.

papers.title: Diffusion models for dynamic volatility surface generation and data-driven hedging
papers.summary: Diffusion models generate arbitrage-consistent dynamic SPX implied-volatility surfaces that yield hedges with near-zero tracking error and lower tail risk.

papers.title: VertiFuseX: Generalizable Financial Forecasting via Multi-Stream Temporal Fusion
papers.summary: A hybrid LSTM with penultimate-layer fusion cuts stock index forecast errors 30-54% and lowers drawdowns in trading simulations.

papers.title: Complements or Substitutes? Technology Adoption and Clinical Care Utilization: Evidence from Automated Insulin Delivery
papers.summary: Automated insulin delivery adoption increases diabetologist visits, consistent with automation complementing clinical labor, though sensitive to trend assumptions.

papers.title: Policy Targeting with Binary Classification Trees: an Application to Rural Hospital Closures
papers.summary: A maximizing-distance classification tree identifies a high-risk rural hospital closure subgroup that standard CART misses.

papers.title: Generative Marketing Mix Modeling: A Causal Inference Framework Linking GEO and GEM to Business Impact
papers.summary: Proposes Generative Marketing Mix Modeling to causally estimate business effects of generative engine optimization and marketing, with identification conditions and simulation evidence.

papers.title: Deep Learning of Robust Market Making under Regime-Switching Order Flow
papers.summary: A distributional deep RL market maker outperforms GLFT and, with change-point signals, stays profitable under regime-switching order flow.

papers.title: Adversarial Training for Tabular Credit Scoring: A Multi-Attack Robustness Evaluation in P2P Lending
papers.summary: Benchmarks adversarial attacks on ML credit scoring in P2P lending; single-attack defenses overstate robustness while mixed-attack training gives balanced resilience.

papers.title: AI Innovation and Firm Performance in the Medical Device Industry
papers.summary: Using FDA clearances, external AI collaboration drives AI medical device introduction, especially for small firms, and AI device introduction raises labour productivity.

papers.title: AI for AI: Optimizing Additional Infrastructure Build-out to Power Artificial Intelligence Data Centers
papers.summary: Models data-center electricity demand and stochastic generation investment, showing uncertainty and overbuild risks may weaken incentives to invest fast enough to stabilize prices.

papers.title: AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery
papers.summary: Proposes a reinforcement-learning method with reward-jump memory and stochastic critic for formulaic alpha discovery, delivering stable gains across equity universes.

papers.title: Nyström Attention Matches Full Attention for Cross-Sectional Stock Prediction
papers.summary: Low-rank Nyström attention matches full inter-stock attention in MASTER for stock prediction, though cross-stock modules give no gain at large universes.

papers.title: ACT, WAIT, or EXPERIMENT: A Causal Governance Framework for Retail Price Optimization Under Abstentions
papers.summary: Causal pricing framework combining double ML and conformal prediction lets retailers abstain when elasticity estimates are unreliable, sharply reducing estimation error on synthetic data.

papers.title: Access to Live AI Advice and Behavior Under Risk: An Incentivized Experiment
papers.summary: Incentivized experiment finds no evidence that access to live interactive AI advice changes individuals' risk aversion in lottery choices.

papers.title: The Profit Alignment Problem: How Profit Mandates Induce Alignment Failures in LLMs
papers.summary: Adding profit mandates to prompts makes LLMs dismiss safety risks more often and suppress board escalation recommendations, revealing motivated reasoning under business objectives.

papers.title: Simplifying Cyber Cat(astrophe)s with Cyber Kittens: Power Law Plausibility for Cyber Insurance Risks
papers.summary: Using LLM-extracted insurance claims, cyber losses plausibly follow a power law, implying a 100x event roughly every 206 years costing 100-250B USD.

papers.title: CausalVerify: End-to-End Verification of Causal Analyses by Language Models
papers.summary: Benchmark shows LLM-written causal analyses often fail to recover estimands even when code runs; reference designs raise recovery from 15% to 51.5%.

papers.title: Explainable Deep Learning for Price-Trade Dynamics: From Black-Box Forecasts to Effective Parametric Models
papers.summary: Explainable neural networks uncover nonlinear price-trade dynamics in high-frequency data, motivating a parsimonious SHAP-inspired parametric microstructure model.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Equity and Crypto Markets: Progress, Profitability Evidence, and the Limits of Automated Investing
papers.summary: Review finds AI progress in equity and crypto investing is mainly upstream, with no architecture shown to deliver persistent, capacity-aware net alpha.

papers.title: Dynamic Spatial Bayesian Machine Learning Model: Applications to Intergenerational Economic Mobility and Geographic Income Inequality in the United States
papers.summary: Dynamic spatial Bayesian tree model performs best across simulations and applies to US county intergenerational mobility and income inequality.

papers.title: Identification and Estimation of Intergenerational Income Mobility Measures
papers.summary: Debiased machine learning missing-data method removes life-cycle bias, raising US intergenerational income elasticity estimates to about 0.64.
